# UX Checklist: Retention And Deletion Execution

**Purpose**: Validate deletion, retention, report, accessibility, localization, and clean-room UI requirement quality before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the whole-meeting delete confirmation specified with bounded 2brain Rec copy rather than generic destructive copy? [Completeness, Spec FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are deleting and deleted meeting destinations required to show a deletion report rather than the original transcript/audio/notes content? [Coverage, Spec US1/FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are report rows specified for active server purge, local desktop purge, backup expiry, MediaScribe, Langfuse, workflow/temp state, diagnostics, exports, and post-egress limits? [Completeness, Spec FR-008/SC-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are retryable and terminal deletion failures required to be visually and semantically distinct? [Coverage, Spec FR-020/SC-007]
- [x] CHK005 Are compact embedded desktop routes included so lifecycle truth remains visible inside the macOS shell? [Completeness, Quickstart §Web UI Validation]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the browser/server ownership boundary clear enough to avoid implementing deletion policy or dependency truth inside desktop UI code? [Clarity, Plan Structure Decision]
- [x] CHK007 Are pending local purge, local unreachable, and local expiry reliance states understandable without implying local cleanup was verified? [Clarity, Spec FR-012]
- [x] CHK008 Are backup pending expiry and external dependency unknown/unsupported states worded as truth states rather than implementation errors? [Clarity, Spec US4/FR-009/FR-015]
- [x] CHK009 Are clean-room constraints explicit enough to use Krisp as IA/state reference without copying copy, assets, icons, proprietary visuals, or private screenshots? [Consistency, Spec FR-024]
- [x] CHK010 Are synthetic screenshot and no-private-data requirements documented for UI evidence? [Evidence, Quickstart §Browser Screenshot Evidence]

## Accessibility And Localization

- [x] CHK011 Are deletion state labels required to fit dense cabinet rows, right panels, modal/report surfaces, and embedded desktop widths? [Clarity, UX Contract]
- [x] CHK012 Can report state be understood without relying on color alone? [Accessibility, Spec FR-004]
- [x] CHK013 Are destructive and retry actions expected to have accessible names and safe focus behavior? [Accessibility, Spec US1/US5]

## Notes

- UX checklist passes. The requirements preserve existing 2brain Rec cabinet density while turning planned governance slots into truthful lifecycle surfaces.
